# Summary

Explain the purpose of this change and what it improves.

# Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Improvement / refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security-related change
- [ ] Other (explain below)

# Checklist

- [ ] Code is deterministic and privilege-correct
- [ ] No drift, dead code, or unnecessary complexity introduced
- [ ] Makefile indentation uses tabs
- [ ] Shell scripts are POSIX-compliant (unless documented)
- [ ] No vendor scripts, binary blobs, or generated artifacts added
- [ ] All assumptions and dependencies are explicit
- [ ] Commit message clearly describes the change

# Testing

Describe how you validated the change (dry-run, local test, etc.).

# Additional Notes

Anything else reviewers should know.
